requirement:
An mdBook chapter MAY declare a named definition using a fenced `{definition}` directive. Definitions MUST use the same chapter-qualified names, identifier rules, fence rules, and nonempty-body rules as requirements and examples. Names MUST be unique across all three kinds.

Each definition MUST declare exactly one nonempty `:phrase:` option before its explanatory body. The phrase MUST be interpreted as plain text. Definitions MUST NOT require their own evidence records or determinations.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Each obligation has marked code, and each one that needs a test has one.

**Obligations and code**
- **Shared name, identifier and fence rules.** `definition_blocks` (src/lib.rs) recognises `{definition}` fences alongside `{req}` and `{example}`, using the same `colon_fence`, `valid_name` and closing-fence logic. `collect_definitions` (src/evidence.rs) applies the same chapter-qualified naming, invalid-name check, missing-closing-fence error and "has no text" error to all three kinds. All are `{impl}`-marked.
- **Uniqueness across all three kinds.** `collect_definitions` keeps one `definitions` map. A name that collides across kinds reports "duplicate … first declared at …".
- **Exactly one nonempty `:phrase:` before the body.** `terms::declaration` (src/terms.rs) rejects four cases: a missing or empty phrase, a phrase that is not the first line, an empty body, and a duplicate `:phrase:` line. `collect_definitions` reports these as `definition <name>: …`.
- **Phrase as plain text.** `terms::escaped_phrase` escapes Markdown and HTML characters. `replace_definitions` in src/lib.rs uses it.
- **No evidence records or determinations required.** In `inspect_repository_with_progress`, the orphan check filters out `DefinitionKind::Term`. The missing-evidence loop and the `validate_references` subjects also exclude terms.

**Tests**
- `invalid_declarations_and_reference_targets_are_reported` covers four cases:
  - the phrase is missing;
  - the phrase is empty;
  - there are duplicate phrases;
  - the body is empty.

  It also covers a missing closing fence and a definition whose name duplicates a requirement.
- `phrases_are_plain_links_and_markdown_literals_are_preserved` asserts that `*alpha* & <beta>` renders as escaped plain text.
- The `fixture` helper has `glossary.a` and `glossary.b` with no evidence files. Tests such as `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` assert that validation reports no errors, so definitions need no evidence records.
- Invalid-name handling has no definition-specific test. The code path has no branch on kind, so it needs none of its own.

No unspecified behaviour showed up in the `{impl}` code.
